description_en: Queries the history logs of natural language queries
description_zh: 查询自然语言查询历史日志
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge query-ask-luma-log --agent-name demo-luma-agent --after eyJ0cyI6MTcxN... --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAskLumaLog

parameters.help_en: The agent name. If this parameter is not specified, logs of all agents are queried
parameters.help_zh: Agent名称, 不填则查询全部
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The cursor. Set this parameter to the messageId of the last entry on the previous page
parameters.help_zh: 游标, 上一页最后一条的 messageId
parameters.name: after

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回条数, 默认20, 最大50
parameters.name: limit
